source: ECB Report on a digital euro (Wikipedia; ECB timeline)
content: Eurosystem publishes its report on a digital euro setting out scenarios for issuance; first official signal of a possible project
Public consultation launched following the report; no new design content
Consultation closes with record participation; preliminary results rank privacy highest; no design decision
Executive Board member states before the European Parliament that a holding limit of around EUR 3000 per person is under consideration; first quantitative signal of a cap
Full consultation results published; privacy 43 percent top concern; no design decision
Governing Council launches the 24-month investigation phase of the digital euro project
